cases.text: Confirming that the slab edge at gridline A is shown as 8 inches on S-101 and is the same condition as detail 4/S-102. Proceed as drawn.
Provide the 75-ton chiller, not the 60-ton unit scheduled on M-601. Load calculations were revised after bid.
Please confirm that the paint color in the media center is PT-3 from the finish schedule on A-601. The sample on site looks right to us.
Use 24-inch deep footings at gridlines C to E per revised detail 4/S-201, in place of the 18-inch footings shown on the original sheet.
ASI-05: Sheet A-102 is reissued to correct a typo in the room number for Room 114. No change to the work.
The District would like 12 additional data drops in Classrooms 201 through 206. Please send a price.
Either anchor type listed in Section 05 50 00 is acceptable at the guardrail posts. Select based on availability.
Clarification: the east stair railing shall be stainless steel, not the painted steel shown on A-401.
Per Section 03 30 00, all slabs on grade are 4,000 psi concrete. The note on S-001 is referring to the same requirement.
Reroute the main supply duct below the beam at gridline 5 and add a soffit to enclose it. See sketch SK-12.
Yes, the dishwasher in Kitchen 105 is contractor-furnished and is listed in Section 11 40 00. No change.
Please also paint the existing stair in Wing B to match the new work. The District would appreciate it as a courtesy.
ASI-11: No cost impact is expected. Install an additional 2 inches of insulation at all roof edges.
The 'typ.' dimension on 5/A-301 applies to all four bays shown on the plan.
Approved as noted: provide 2-inch insulated panels, not the 1-inch panels listed in Section 07 42 13.
Minutes record that submittal review remains 14 days and resubmittals remain 10 days, as stated in Section 8.2.
The fire marshal requires an additional fire damper at each shaft penetration on Level 2. Install per detail 6/M-501.
Use the 2-hour fire-rated door shown on A-501, not the 1-hour door in the spec.
Provide the 8-inch CMU for the full height of the wall, as noted in Detail 3/A-301.
Each roofing membrane layer needs a 7-day cure before the next layer is placed, per the manufacturer's instructions already required by Section 07 54 00.
Conduit routing is at your discretion as long as the clearances on E-401 are met.
Please replace the specified mortise locksets with electrified access control hardware at all exterior doors.
The 'by others' note on the casework drawing refers to the Owner's furniture vendor, per the General Conditions. It is not in your scope.
Test results show the slab in Room 118 cannot be patched as drawn. Remove and replace the slab.
OAC minutes: the Architect asked that all corridor ceilings be raised to 10'-0" above finished floor in place of the 9'-0" shown.
The fire-rated gypsum board on the corridor side is Type X, 5/8-inch, as already specified in Section 09 29 00.
The superintendent was asked verbally to relocate the main electrical room to the west side. Confirming by email.
Use the sealant listed in Section 07 92 00 at all control joints, including those on the east elevation.
The District requests turnover of the gym addition 6 weeks before Substantial Completion for a summer program.
Paint finish in the corridors is eggshell per the finish schedule on A-601. The 'high-performance' note on the cover sheet refers to the same product.
